## What this is

`gangtise-agent` is a local Agent Skill. Call Gangtise Agent OpenAPI for research Markdown: one-pagers, investment logic, peer comparison, earnings reviews, themes, outlines, hot topics, and more.

**Keywords**: `一页通`, `投资逻辑`, `同业对比`, `绩点评`, `主题跟踪`, `调研提纲`, `热点话题`, `gangtise agent`

## Install

1. Download: [gangtise-agent.zip](https://gts-download.obs.cn-east-3.myhuaweicloud.com/skills/gangtise-agent.zip)
2. Unzip to get `gangtise-agent/`, copy it into your `skills/` directory
3. Follow `SKILL.md` for runtime setup (install deps if listed)

Configure `GTS_ACCESS_KEY` / `GTS_SECRET_KEY` from the [open platform](https://open-platform.gangtise.com/), or follow the skill’s auth file instructions.

## Example prompts

- 贵州茅台能不能给我一页通，核心要素浓缩一下？
- 比亚迪的投资逻辑主线是什么，用 Markdown 整理给我。
- 宁德时代和同行比，竞争格局和差异点帮我写一版同业对比。
- 宁德时代 2025 年三季报业绩，帮我做份绩点评。
- 如果飞天茅台批价低点真是 1500，正方反方论据分别是什么？
